questions.question: 5 cubes, each of edge 4 cm, are joined end to end. What is the total surface area of the resulting cuboid?
questions.solution:
When 5 cubes are joined end to end, it will form a cuboid.

The length of cuboid so formed will be = 5 × 4 = 20 cm

And the height and the breadth of the cuboid will remain the same. i.e. 4 cm.

The total surface area of the cuboid = 2(lb + bh + lh)

= 2(20 × 4 + 4 × 4 + 20 × 4) = 2(80 + 16 + 80) = 352 cm²

questions.question: If a³ - b³ = 208 and a - b = 4, then (a + b)² - ab is equal to∶
questions.solution:
a³ - b³ = 208

⇒ (a - b)(a² + ab + b²) = 208

⇒ 4(a² + ab + b²) = 208

⇒ a² + ab + b² = 52

Now,

(a + b)² - ab = a² + 2ab + b² - ab = a² + ab + b² = 52

questions.question: A shopkeeper sold two articles for Rs. 9471 each. On one, he gained 23% and on the other, he lost 23%. What is the overall percentage gain or loss?
questions.solution:
Successive percentage change is given by∶

x + y + xy/100

Given∶

On one, he gained 23% and on the other, he lost 23%

⇒ x = 23 and y = -23

⇒ Overall percentage change = 23 - 23 + (23)(-23)/100 = -5.29%

∴ The overall percentage loss of 5.29%.

questions.question: The sides of a triangle are 10 cm, 24 cm and 26 cm. At each of its vertices, circles of radius 3.5 cm are drawn. What is the area of the triangle excluding the portion covered by the sectors of the circles? (π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
As the sides of the triangle 10 cm, 24 cm and 26 cm are triplets, the triangle will be a right angle triangle with side having length 26 cm as hypotenuse.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c96d9196af125185979b891dc2858a3766d4924e587a07d5180881ea536e26b.png] 

⇒ The area of the triangle will be = ½ × base × altitude = 1/2 × 24 × 10 = 120 cm²

Let the three angles of the triangle be 90°, x° and y°

⇒ The area of the three sectors will be = (90/360) × π r² + (x/360) × π r² + (y/360) × π r²

⇒ (90 + x + y)/360 × π r²

As sum of all three angles of triangle is 180°, so 90 + x + y = 180°

The area of the three sectors will be = (180/360) × π r² = 180/360 × 22/7 × (3.5)² = 19.25 cm²

The area of the triangle excluding the portion covered by the sectors of the circles = 120 - 19.25

⇒ 100.75 cm²

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 20,000 is invested for 15 months at the interest for 10% per annum compounded half yearly. What is the percentage gain, correct to once decimal place, at the end of 15 month?
questions.solution:
Rate of interest = 10% per annum

Rate of interest = 5% per half year

Interest gained in first six months on Rs. 20000 = 5/100 × 20000 = Rs. 1000

Interest gained in next six month = 5/100 × 20000 + 5/100 × 1000 = 1000 + 50 = Rs. 1050

Rate of interest for last three months will be = 5/2 = 2.5%

Interest gained in last three month = 2.5/100 × 20000 + 2.5/100 × 1000 + 2.5/100 × 1050

⇒ 500 + 25 + 26.25 = Rs. 551.25

Total interest gained in 15 months = 1000 + 1050 + 551.25 = Rs. 2601.25

Percentage gain = 2601.25/20000 × 100 = 13%

questions.question: What is the sum of digits of the least number, which when divided by 15, 18 and 24 leaves the remainder 8 in each case and is also divisible by 13?
questions.solution:
15 = 3 × 5

18 = 2 × 3 × 3

24 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3

LCM = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 = 360

Before leaving remainder 8, the number required is 368.

368/13 = 28.31

So, this is not a divisible by 13.

360 × 2 = 720 + 8 = 728

⇒ 728 ÷ 13 = 56

Correct number is 728.

∴ Sum of these digits is 17.

questions.question: If the six-digit number 4x4y96 is divisible by 88, then what will be the value of (x + 2y)?[y = smallest number > 0]
questions.solution:
if the number is divisible by 88, it has to be divisible by 11 also.

To check divisibility by 11,

⇒ 4 + 4 + 9 = x + y + 6

⇒ x + y = 11

Also, the number should be divisible by 8.

To check the divisibility by 8 last three digits must be divisible by 8.

Y96 should be divisible by 8.

The value y = 2 (least) it divisible by 8.

∴ x + 2y = (x + y) + y = 11 + 2 = 13.

questions.question: The efficiencies of A, B and C are in the ratio 4 ∶ 5 ∶ 6. Working together, they can complete a work in 12 days. In how many days will A alone be able to complete that work?
questions.solution:
Total work = sum of efficiencies × time taken together

Total work = (4 + 5 + 6) × 12 = 180 units

A alone will take = total work/A’s individual efficiency

⇒ 180/4 = 45 days

questions.question: Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 6 hours and 9 hours respectively. They are opened alternately for 1 hour each starting with pipe A first. In how many hours the tank will be filled?
questions.solution:
Capacity of the tank = LCM of the time taken by A and B.

Capacity of the tank = 18 units

A’s efficiency = 18/6 = 3 units per hour

B’s efficiency = 18/9 = 2 units per hour

2 hours work for A and B = (3 + 2) = 5 units

⇒ 2 × 3 hours = 3 × 5 or 15 units

⇒ 6 hours = 15 units

⇒ 7 hours = 18 units. (At last A fills remaining 3 units)

∴ Tank will be filled in 7 hours.

questions.question: The average of 16 numbers is 48. The average of the first 7 numbers is 45 and the average of the next 6 numbers is 52. If the 14th number is 11 less than the 15th number and is 5 more than the 16th number, then the average of the 15th and 16th number is∶
questions.solution:
The sum of 16 numbers = 48 × 16 = 768

The sum of first 7 numbers = 45 × 7 = 315

The sum of next 6 numbers = 52 × 6 = 312

The sum of the last 3 numbers = 768 - 315 - 312 = 141

Let the 16th number be x.

14th number = x + 5

14th number = 15th number - 11

⇒ x + 5 = 15th number - 11

⇒ 15th number = x + 16

The sum of the last 3 numbers = 141

⇒ x + x + 5 + x + 16 = 141

⇒ x = 40

15th number = 40 + 16 = 56

The average of the 15th and 16th number = (56 + 40)/2 = 48

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Deflection of the first seven numbers from average = 7 × (45 - 48) = -21

Deflection of the next 6 numbers from average = (52 - 48) × 6 = +24

Total deflection of 24 - 21 = 3

Deflection of the last three numbers from the average = -3

The sum of last three numbers should = 48 × 3 - 3 = 141

⇒ x + x + 5 + x + 16 = 141

⇒ x = 40

15th number = 40 + 16 = 56

The average of the 15th and 16th number = (56 + 40)/2 = 48

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 4 ∶ 5. If their HCF is 16, then the sum of these two numbers is∶
questions.solution:
Given:

The ratio of numbers = 4 : 5

HCF of the numbers = 16

Concept used:

The largest number that divides two or more numbers is the highest common factor (HCF) for those numbers.

Calculation:

Let the two numbers be 4x and 5x

HCF of 4x and 5x = x

HCF = 16

⇒ x = 16

∴ Sum of two numbers = 4x + 5x = 9x = 9 × 16 = 144

∴ The sum of these two numbers is 144.

questions.question: A boat can go 30 km downstream and 24 km upstream in 2 hours 27 minutes. Also, it can go 20 km downstream and 8 km upstream 74 minutes. What is the speed of the boat in still water in km/h?
questions.solution:
2 h 27 min = 49/20 h

74 min = 37/30 h

Let the speed of boat be x km/h and speed of stream be y km/h 

frac{{30}}{{x + y}} + frac{{24}}{{x - y}} = frac{{49}}{{20}} ----(1)

frac{{20}}{{x + y}} + (8)/({x - y)} = frac{{37}}{{30}} ----(2)

Multiplying eq..(1) by 2 and eq. (2) by 3 and then subtracting eq. (2) from eq. (1)

frac{{24}}{{x - y}} = frac{{72}}{{60}}

x - y = 20 ----(3)

Putting x - y = 20 in eq. (1)

x + y = 24 ---- (4)

From eq. (3) and eq. (4)

x = 22

∴ Speed of boat = 22 km/h
